result.title: CRLoMTL: Conflict-Resolution through Low-rank matrices for Multi-Task Learning
result.comment: Accepted at the British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC 2026)
result.summary: Multi-task learning (MTL) improves model efficiency by sharing representations across related vision tasks, but it often suffers from negative transfer when task updates interfere with one another. Existing conflict-mitigation methods typically operate in gradient space, requiring explicit task-gradient manipulation and additional optimization steps. We propose Conflict-Resolution through Low-Rank Matrices for Multi-Task Learning (CRLoMTL), a parameter-efficient framework that mitigates task interference in the low-rank parameter-update space. CRLoMTL learns task-specific LoRA updates through task-specific passes, where each task updates its own low-rank matrices, and integrates these updates through global shared-subspace fusion. Specifically, we introduce a shared-subspace resolver based on singular value decomposition (SVD), referred to as the SVD resolver, which extracts a common low-dimensional orthonormal basis across task adapters and projects task updates into this shared space before merging them into a single deployment-time update. The resulting update can be folded into the backbone, preserving the inference structure of the original model without additional runtime branches. Experiments with Swin Transformer backbones on PASCAL-Context, NYUD-v2, and CelebA show that CRLoMTL achieves a favorable accuracy-parameter trade-off, improving over single-task baselines by up to 2.77% on PASCAL-Context, 5.03% on NYUD-v2, and 3.50% on CelebA, while training only a small fraction of the parameters used by single-task models.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 CRLoMTL：在低秩参数更新空间而非梯度空间缓解多任务干扰，各任务训练独立 LoRA，再用基于 SVD 的共享子空间解析器提取公共正交基、投影并合并为单一可折叠更新，在 Swin 骨干上验证精度与参数权衡。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 主线无直接关系，但其低秩共享子空间投影与任务更新融合方式，可能为组合多个推理期或训练期 latent 技能适配器、抑制相互干扰提供可供核查的线索。
